messages:
oliver: Starting post-deploy structured-output smoke for this release. Noticed the structured-parser probe failing JSON-schema validation for the assistant response in eu-central1.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-24-canary -> canary. Running postdeploy probes (ci: 4843210000).
ml-qa: FYI: structured-parser probe reports 12/500 failures where the assistant omits the required \"metadata.id\" field in tool outputs. Payload sample attached in probe logs.
kevin: Any latency/5xx correlated?
ml-qa: No, errors are schema validation only. Responses return 200 but body missing field. Looks like a model variant change in output formatting.
nora: Suggest holding rollout and pin eu-central1 to previous variant. Also add a temporary linting middleware to the route that injects a fallback metadata.id when missing so downstream consumers don't break.
sam: Agreed. Hold global promote. Action: pin eu-central1 to v2026-03-22 and enable quick middleware patch.
deploy-bot: Pin request submitted: POST /api/v1/route/pin {\"region\":\"eu-central1\",\"model_variant\":\"v2026-03-22\"} -> 200 OK.
deploy-bot: Middleware patch deployed to edge lint service in eu-central1 (canary flag enabled).
kevin: Applying patch reduces immediate consumer errors by filling missing metadata.id with generated uuid. Still want runtime team to investigate model-output formatting delta. Filing RT-6380.
ml-qa: Re-ran structured probe against pinned region: failures dropped to 0/500. Re-run against original canary variant in a controlled canary with middleware off shows the omission reproduces.
oliver: Plan: keep eu-central1 pinned for 1 hour, run focused A/B tests on the canary variant with a synthetic dataset of structured calls, and if model variant doesn't conform, schedule a canary rollback for affected pools.
sam: Add note to release notes: \"eu-central1 pinned to v2026-03-22 due to structured output schema regression in canary; middleware fallback applied to protect downstream consumers. Runtime investigating.\"
deploy-bot: Release notes updated.
nora: Also add an automonitor rule: if structured-parser probe failure rate >0.5% in first 10m after promote, auto-pin region and open P1.
kevin: RT-6380 created and assigned to runtime@. I'll attach probe payloads and model diff excerpt.
ml-qa: We'll run the A/B and share results in 30m. If regression persists, execute canary rollback and open a postmortem.
sam: Thanks team. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
